_meta.purpose: Verified local (city/municipal) income and wage tax rates, for metro-level take-home pay differentiation on usmoneyhq.com.
_meta.status: NOT WIRED. This file is intentionally not consumed by the app.
why_not_wired: Only 3 of 22 target jurisdictions could be verified from an official page. The remainder returned HTTP 403 bot walls (kcmo.gov, michigan.gov, nyc.gov), connection timeouts (stlouis-mo.gov), or restructured/404 pages (detroitmi.gov).

New York City's tax is a graduated four-bracket schedule. Only the married-filing-jointly bracket table was captured; the single-filer table was not. Publishing one flat NYC rate would misstate most filers.

Yonkers is NOT an income tax rate. 16.75% is a surcharge on the resident's New York State income tax liability (Form IT-201 line 55). Rendering it as a 16.75% income rate would overstate the tax by roughly an order of magnitude.

The live /guides/take-home-pay-by-metro-2026 page already discloses that local city income taxes are excluded, and names New York City, Philadelphia and Columbus. The published figures are state-level by design and stated as such, not silently wrong.
_meta.method: Primary sources only: state tax department form instructions and the city's own revenue department. No blogs, no CPA marketing pages, no listicles. Each record carries a verbatim quote containing the rate and the HTTP status observed when fetched.
_meta.next_step_to_unblock: Obtain a free Census API key (api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html) for per-city income/home-value data, or capture the full NYC single + MFJ bracket tables and Philadelphia's School Income Tax before any of this is wired.

verified.rate_is: lowest bracket of a graduated schedule, NOT a flat rate
verified.threshold_note: Graduated NYC resident schedule (married filing jointly): 3.078% to $21,600; 3.762% to $45,000; 3.819% to $90,000; 3.876% above $90,000. Single-filer bracket table NOT yet captured.

verified.rate_is: SURCHARGE ON STATE TAX LIABILITY, NOT A RATE ON INCOME
verified.threshold_note: DO NOT implement as an income rate. Yonkers residents pay a surcharge equal to 16.75% of their New York State income tax liability. Effective rate on income is roughly 16.75% of the state effective rate, i.e. well under 1.2% of wages.
verified.source_quote: n. Yonkers resident tax rate (16.75%) n. __0.1675___ o. Multiply line m by line n. Enter this amount on Form IT-201, line 55

verified.threshold_note: Applies to salaries, wages, commissions and other compensation; no threshold. Philadelphia also levies a separate School Income Tax on unearned income, rate not verified here.
